A few weeks ago, as a buyer, I had the per fect illustration of how the ongoing relationship of a large sale can in fluence decisions. I was involved in two sales on the same day. The first sale was a small one. I needed a new overhead protector for my office, so I had asked a local supplier to send a sales rep to talk with me. The character who appeared was a remarkably unlovely individual who wouldn't have been out of place selling indecent photographs in the back streets of Rio. "It's your lucky day," he began' I'm sure you can't wait to hear the deal I've got for you!" Actually, what I couldn't wait to do was to get him out of my office. But his price was good, I needed a projector, and I'd never have to see him again.
